theme.description: Professional, earthy yet functional dashboard. 'ORGANIC & EARTHY' mixed with 'SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST'. Clean, data-heavy, but with subtle warm tones (wood/furniture reference) instead of generic tech blue.

typography.rules: Avoid using Inter for headings. Use tracking-tight for large headings. Maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text below 18px. Do not center-align paragraphs or dense data tables.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use subtle nested shadows for cards and dropdowns (e.g., shadow-sm for default state, shadow-md for hover/active state).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E5E5, rounded corners (max 8px border-radius) for a slightly softer, earthy feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for data-heavy dashboard cells to prevent visual distraction, but acceptable for sticky headers or modals.

grids_layouts.dashboard_grid: High density grid. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-column layout. Gap: gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing for breathing room. Tailwind scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Ensure internal padding for bordered containers to prevent text collision.
grids_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content, lists, forms, tabular data.

component_rules.tables: Use Shadcn/UI tables. Must be responsive. High contrast headers. Striped or hoverable rows for readability.
component_rules.cards: Go flat, rectangular, dense styles. Avoid over-using card wrappers if a pure grid suffices.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn forms (Input, Select). Required: Explicit focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50).
component_rules.buttons: Modern, slightly rounded (rounded-md). Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:brightness-110). Primary action buttons use primary color.
component_rules.navigation: Sidebar for desktop, hamburger + drawer for mobile. Sticky header with user profile and role indication.

motion.rules: Micro-interactions on hover (buttons, table rows, links). Subtle entrance animations for dashboard widgets (staggered fade-in). Do not use 'transition-all'.

accessibility.contrast: APCA preferred or WCAG AA minimum. Focus rings mandatory.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'AGFDATA', a complex furniture production and inventory dashboard.
Implement Role-Based Access Control UI: Admin (full access), Staff (hide prices, manage specific sections), Guest (view only, hide prices and craftsman names).
Implement the following main menus: Database Barang, PO, Barang Masuk, Staffing, SPK, Progres Barang, Rekap Data.
Ensure all menus dynamically auto-fill data based on the 'PO' and 'Database Barang' structures as defined in requirements.
Implement Export options (Excel/CSV/PDF) and Print layouts (especially for SPK and PO).
Make sure the UI is mobile responsive (critical requirement: 'bisa dibuka di browser hp').
Use lucide-react for crisp, professional iconography.
Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts for 'Rekap Data' visual summaries.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds in dropdowns, sticky headers, or modals.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where applicable, but not on data tables.
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Add transitions for specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`).
Use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use proper icon libraries.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than usual) to avoid cramped designs.
DO NOT use placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Ensure the final dashboard is accessible, with focus states and contrast compliance.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
